title: Python Basics
description: A simple, beginner-friendly course covering the core concepts of Python through clear, bite-sized lessons.

chapters.title: What Is Python?
chapters.shortDescription: A simple overview of Python and why it's widely used.

chapters.title: Python Syntax Essentials
chapters.shortDescription: Basic rules like indentation, keywords, and how Python reads code.

chapters.title: Variables and Data Types
chapters.shortDescription: Understanding numbers, strings, booleans, and how Python stores values.

chapters.title: Working With Strings
chapters.shortDescription: Basic string operations like slicing, formatting, and common methods.

chapters.title: Operators in Python
chapters.shortDescription: Learn arithmetic, comparison, and logical operators used in expressions.

chapters.title: Conditional Statements
chapters.shortDescription: How to use if, elif, and else to make decisions in code.

chapters.title: Loops: for and while
chapters.shortDescription: Using loops to repeat tasks and process sequences.

chapters.title: Lists and Basic List Methods
chapters.shortDescription: Storing multiple items and using common list operations.

chapters.title: Tuples and Sets
chapters.shortDescription: Immutable tuples and unique-value sets explained simply.

chapters.title: Dictionaries
chapters.shortDescription: Key-value pairs and how to access, add, or update data.

chapters.title: Functions: Define and Use
chapters.shortDescription: Creating reusable blocks of code with parameters and returns.

chapters.title: Built-in Functions
chapters.shortDescription: Useful built-ins like len(), range(), sum(), and more.

chapters.title: Error Handling Basics
chapters.shortDescription: Understanding common Python errors and simple try-except usage.

chapters.title: Intro to Modules
chapters.shortDescription: How to import and use Python’s built-in modules.

chapters.title: Working With Simple Files
chapters.shortDescription: Reading from and writing to text files using Python.
